classification: Pre-existing main product race, not introduced by this PR

case.name: a reply sent before a reload is not offered again in the composer
case.firstAttempt: Failed after30 seconds waiting for EmailSendAttempt after reload

mechanism: claimSend persists leaseUntil=now+60000; reload before the pending submit settles leaves the lease held. The new page skips the attempt until expiry.
impact: Up to60-second status recovery delay after reload during slow submit; no resend or data loss
evidence: Failed attempt completed SendEmailMessage after two draft/operation calls and CalendarChanges; passing attempt completed it before those calls. Both recorded PendingEmailSends six times; only the pass recorded EmailSendAttempt.
testBoundary: 01ed1bb6f56 waits for the submit abort and reads the exact IndexedDB record until leaseUntil==0 before reload; original recovery and editor assertions unchanged.
productFix: Separate follow-up; no production source changed by the test fix.
